financings_after_balance_sheet.what: January 2026 underwritten public offering of 5,897,435 shares at $19.50
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In January 2026, the Company completed an underwritten public offering of its common stock, issuing 5,897,435 shares at a public offering price of $19.50 per share for net proceeds of $107.6 million

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Exercise of underwriters' option for 884,615 shares in February 2026
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In February 2026, the Company issued 884,615 shares of its common stock upon exercise of the underwriters’ option in the January 2026 Offering, resulting in net proceeds of $16.2 million, net of underwriting discounts and commissions.

warrants.quote: the Lenders were concurrently issued warrants to purchase 24,968 shares of our common stock at an exercise price of $10.26 per share, with a term of 10 years.
